headline: Toast Faces FTC Lawsuit Over Business Contract Practices
summary: Toast faces a lawsuit filed by the Federal Trade Commission regarding its business contract practices.
why: Antitrust and trade practice lawsuits by federal regulators pose legal and operational risks that can impact software-as-a-service business models and valuations.

impacts.name: Toast Inc
impacts.why: Regulatory lawsuits create legal uncertainty and potential compliance costs that can weigh on investor sentiment.
